entities.name: Rajputs
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Warrior clans of northern India who built magnificent hilltop forts and followed a chivalric code (Rajput dharma). Their martial traditions, honor system, and fierce independence made them legendary — they never fully submitted to Mughal rule.
